title: SparseMoE capacity, overflow & second-choice routing
protocol: Frozen4-expert model; two fresh256-sample batches; capacities0.5/1/1.5 and unlimited; ordered dispatch, drop→zero vs second-ranked fallback. All-item and admitted-only RMSE both recorded.
findings: Dropped items remain in all-item RMSE; coverage cannot be hidden by reporting admitted-only quality.
Second-choice routing changes probabilities and expert semantics; not guaranteed improvement.
Batch-order routing is deterministic but order-sensitive; not distributed AllToAll throughput.
scope: AI-assisted new local stress experiments; no retraining, external API, private data or production claim
